description: Add an item to the signed-in person's inventory and return the saved item. Sets the same fields as the app: name, description, collection, location, quantity, purchase price and date, condition, tags, notes, and list (inventory, wishlist or gift). A wishlist item takes target_price, not current_value: a current_value sent for a wishlist or borrowed item is ignored, and the result says so in value_note. A gift (list_type gift) is something the person plans to give someone. It needs recipient, and takes occasion, gift_date and gift_status (idea, bought or given; a new gift is idea). A gift has no value: a current_value sent for one is ignored and saved as empty, and no market value is looked up. A gift cannot go in a collection. A new inventory or lent item on a US dollar account gets one market value lookup in the background; the result then carries market_lookup: "pending" and market_lookup_note. Nothing is looked up for a wishlist, gift or borrowed item. A new inventory, lent, wishlist or gift item sent with no image_url gets the top suggested product photo straight away, using one image suggestion from this month's allowance; the result then carries photo_attached: true and photo_note. If no photo is found or the allowance is used up, the item is still added with no photo. A borrowed or archived item gets no photo, and an image_url you send is kept. The owner and timestamps come from the signed-in person, not the arguments.

inputSchema.description: Fields the signed-in person can set on a new item

current_value.description: Value of an item the person owns or has lent out. Ignored on wishlist, borrowed and gift items.

gift_date.description: Gift only: the date of the occasion, YYYY-MM-DD. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

gift_status.description: Gift only: idea, bought or given. A new gift is idea. given keeps the item on the gift list. Ignored on every other list.

list_type.description: The list the item is on. gift is something the person plans to give someone: it needs recipient, and it cannot later become inventory, lent or borrowed.

occasion.description: Gift only: what the gift is for, such as Christmas or a birthday. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.

order_number.description: Order number from the store or receipt, as written. Null clears it. Two items can share one.

recipient.description: Gift only: who the gift is for. Required when list_type is gift. Ignored on every other list.

return_by.description: The date the item should go back by, such as the end of a store return window, YYYY-MM-DD. Null clears it. Not the due date of a loan (due_date) and not the warranty end (warranty_expires_at).

source_link.description: A product or order page the person gave, starting with http:// or https://. Null clears it. It is saved as text and never opened.

target_price.description: Wishlist only: the price the person is aiming for. Null clears it. Ignored on every other list.
